name: Keys
summary: Key ring with three keys and a plain tag, hero size; for home, car, door and moving-house scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the lowest key tip sits on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 400 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: motion only; driven by the frame
